answer: Escrowed bonding with a public referral graph blocks fakes at the wharf. A newcomer posts a 40-unit bond, naming a sponsor whose bond is slashed too on cheating. A ridge splits honest from fake: public links flag a star cluster of 100 accounts tied to one sponsor at once. A violet tag marks bonded identities. Making 100 fakes costs 100x40=4,000 units against ~30 units of reward per epoch. An honest agent pays once, keeps the bond 20 epochs.
